olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: A \textit{virtual} number has the form $\overline{abab}$ with $a\neq 0$. Find all virtual numbers of the form $n^2+1$.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2020

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Call a distribution of $nk$ coins in $n$ piles \textit{levelable} if operations (take two piles with even total, redistribute equally) can make all piles equal. Find all $n$ for which any distribution of $nk$ coins in $n$ piles is levelable (for all $k$).
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2020

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Find all $f:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{Z}$ such that if $a+b+c=0$ then $f(a)+f(b)+f(c)=a^2+b^2+c^2$.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2020

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $\triangle ABC$ with $BC>AC$; circle centered at $C$ with radius $AC$ meets $BC$ at $D$. $I$ = incenter; $\Gamma$ = circle through $I$ tangent to $CA$ at $A$. Line $AB$ meets $\Gamma$ at $F\neq A$. Prove $BF=BD$.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2020

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $P(x)$ has real nonneg­ative coefficients. $k$ positive reals $x_1,\ldots,x_k$ with product 1. Prove $P(x_1)+\cdots+P(x_k)\geq kP(1)$.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2020

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $N=p_1^{x_1}\cdots p_k^{x_k}$ is \textit{interoceanic} if $x_1+\cdots+x_k=p_1+\cdots+p_k$. Find all interoceanic numbers less than 2020.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2020
